invariants.name: never_write_down
invariants.protected_property: A record, version, transition, alert, review item, or other derived artifact is never visible to a context that cannot view every material state value or existence fact it embeds.
invariants.trust_boundary: restricted source or prior state to lower-marked background, authoring, refresh, or workflow context
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_operational.security.admit_marking called by MissionDataStore.append; analytic append_version and record_transition supply typed material references
invariants.failure_behavior: Interactive mutation refuses a non-expressible join. Background derivation records a deny-all sealed marking. No weaker record is committed.
invariants.enforcement_scope: prospective for new writes; historical markings are preserved across import, backup, replay, and key lifecycle

invariants.name: material_reference_completeness
invariants.protected_property: Every in-store field that carries a material object reference has one typed policy classification and participates in transitive marking and authority walks; association-only and provenance fields are explicit exclusions.
invariants.trust_boundary: schema evolution or alternate caller to the shared marking and gate policy
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_operational.security material-reference registry plus registry-completeness regression
invariants.failure_behavior: An unclassified reference-shaped schema field fails validation/tests; an unresolved required in-store reference fails closed rather than contributing no marking or authority state.
invariants.enforcement_scope: prospective and historical during authoritative replay walks

invariants.name: authoritative_gate_complete_mediation
invariants.protected_property: A control decision reads authoritative raw state and transitive current basis, never merely the actor-filtered view. Hidden dissent, retraction, dispute, dead status, stale basis, expired temporal scope, or open review blocks approval on plain and signed paths.
invariants.trust_boundary: access-filtered presentation layer to load-bearing authorization decision
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_workbench.authority.authoritative_basis_concerns, called once by the shared report approval command before either plain or signed commit
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse with a typed report-validation concern. Hidden details remain undisclosed; the existence of a blocker may be signalled only within the report's own basis scope.

invariants.name: ed25519_key_lifecycle
invariants.protected_property: Each public key has one permanent actor owner; enrollment, rotation, retirement, revocation, and compromise are append-only and marked without write-down. Multiple bounded active device keys are supported. Historical verification uses the key status at signing time, while compromise is retroactive.
invariants.trust_boundary: bearer-bootstrapped enrollment and registry mutation to cryptographic actor authority
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse conflicting ownership, invalid resurrection, excess active keys, or invalid lifecycle transitions without retiring a working key as a side effect.

invariants.name: bounded_single_use_sessions
invariants.protected_property: Challenge nonces and sessions are short-lived, single-use, actor-bound, bearer-gated at issuance, bounded per owner, and rechecked against live key status on every use.
invariants.trust_boundary: network client to authenticated actor session
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_identity.sessions.SessionManager and authenticated HTTP challenge/time endpoints
invariants.failure_behavior: Expire, evict the flooder's own oldest state, or refuse with AuthError; never evict another principal as attacker-selected collateral.

invariants.name: signed_action_exact_binding_and_order
invariants.protected_property: A signed action binds actor, actor kind, action type, target kind/id, exact target version token, mission, nonce, bounded timestamp, and material command. Verification consumes no authority record; authorization runs after verification; the signed audit record is appended only after successful effect.
invariants.trust_boundary: authenticated key holder to load-bearing product command
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_identity.actions.verify_action plus curunir_workbench.signed_ops shared command application
invariants.failure_behavior: Deterministic refusal status before command execution and before nonce/audit commitment. A successful command is applied once; crash between effect and audit remains an explicitly reported safe-direction limitation.

invariants.name: browser_identity_last_mile
invariants.protected_property: The interactive browser uses a non-extractable WebCrypto Ed25519 device key and canonical bytes independently reproduced by the server; bearer identity cannot substitute for the private key on the signed approval path.
invariants.trust_boundary: interactive browser to HTTP signed-operation endpoint
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_workbench/static/js/identity.js and canonical.js plus server-side verify_action
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse unsupported or non-canonical signing values and invalid wire signatures; explicit bearer fallback does not claim cryptographic non-repudiation.

invariants.name: strict_total_interchange_values
invariants.protected_property: Persisted, signed, imported, provider-returned, and rendered values are deterministic well-formed interchange JSON: no lone surrogate, non-finite float, duplicate key, unsafe mixed container, or unbounded integer conversion reaches canonical persistence.
invariants.trust_boundary: hostile or exotic values to persistence, signing, replication, or response rendering
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_operational.canonical strict validator; edge-specific total scrubbers only convert semantically untrusted proposal/render data before this refusal seam
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse authoritative persistence/import/signature with a typed error and zero bytes committed. Untrusted provider/render data is safely normalized and remains explicitly untrusted.
invariants.enforcement_scope: prospective writes and historical foreign-artifact validation

invariants.name: append_and_torn_tail_durability
invariants.protected_property: The event log is a monotonic hash chain written under one append lock. Readers split only on LF. Recovery holds the same lock and repairs only a non-LF-terminated final write, preserving the original; committed corruption and incompatible versions are refused.
invariants.trust_boundary: process crash or concurrent writer/recovery to durable mission history
invariants.failure_behavior: Typed StoreError with original bytes untouched for anything not proven to be an uncommitted torn tail.

invariants.name: content_addressed_payload_integrity
invariants.protected_property: Payload names equal their SHA-256 content, writes are atomic, reads verify content, and non-regular/symlink/torn slots never yield evidence or a successful backup.
invariants.trust_boundary: filesystem crash or hostile destination/source layout to evidence custody
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: MissionDataStore put_payload/get_payload and shared regular-file primitive
invariants.failure_behavior: Loud StoreError; a safe torn self-repair is allowed only when the caller supplies the correct body whose digest names the slot.

invariants.name: validate_then_install_once
invariants.protected_property: Full restore, delta import, and bundle import strictly parse and preflight the entire authenticated artifact, every event, payload, version, path, destination, and overlap before any authoritative install. Full restore stages and publishes one complete store.
invariants.trust_boundary: foreign, old, tampered, or crash-interrupted artifact to live mission store
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: MissionDataStore validated staged installer and delta.apply_imported_events_locked using the same validators/file primitives
invariants.failure_behavior: Typed refusal with no installed root and no applied delta prefix for any preflight-detectable defect. Hostile omitted payloads fail loudly at read if generic completeness is not decidable.
invariants.enforcement_scope: historical foreign artifacts and prospective installation

invariants.name: guarded_network_egress
invariants.protected_property: Acquisition permits only HTTP(S) destinations whose resolved addresses are all public and rechecks redirect/final URLs before accepting bytes. Alternate numeric, IPv6, userinfo, case, trailing-dot, mapped, transition, multicast, metadata, and reserved-address forms do not bypass policy.
invariants.trust_boundary: attacker-influenced source URL to network and ingestion
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_fabric.transport.SafePublicTransport installed directly by connector base; each hop resolves once and the socket connects only to that validated address set
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse before opening a socket to an unsafe initial or redirect target. DNS answers containing any non-public address are refused, and validated addresses are pinned through connection to close re-resolution rebinding.

invariants.name: provider_governance
invariants.protected_property: A provider call is governed before egress by the effective marking of its material inputs; provider output remains an untrusted candidate requiring human acceptance and exact materialization binding.
invariants.trust_boundary: mission evidence to external model/provider and provider result back to authoritative state
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: curunir_analytic.providers.AnalyticalAssist.propose resolves declared references plus record ids carried in provider cargo against authoritative state; substrate candidate acceptance binds materialization
invariants.failure_behavior: Refuse before provider call when governance is insufficient or any declared reference is unresolved; retain an INVALID inference record for hostile output without admitting it as a candidate.
invariants.enforcement_scope: prospective; provider seam is currently unwired

invariants.name: limits_are_not_negative_evidence
invariants.protected_property: A truncated, throttled, malformed, source-error, or otherwise incomplete read cannot prove absence, removal, retraction, or a lifecycle downgrade. Genuine parsed empty results remain distinguishable.
invariants.trust_boundary: resource cap or source failure to semantic/forecast truth claim
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: execution outcome classification plus semantic truncation classification consumed by change interpretation and forecast absence coverage
invariants.failure_behavior: Record FAILED or UNRESOLVED_CHANGE with explicit warnings; never EMPTY, REMOVED, RETRACTED, or absence-supported FALSE unless the complete source semantics establish it.

invariants.name: bounded_work_and_fault_provenance
invariants.protected_property: Hostile input cannot cause unbounded fetch, parse, retry, fan-out, subprocess output, pending-auth state, or provider serialization. Source/content/network faults are contained as source failures; local custody, memory, and store-integrity faults propagate.
invariants.trust_boundary: hostile content or remote failure to local availability and truthful blame
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: connector/executor provenance boundary, shared XML admission guard, streaming bounded PDF subprocess wrapper, semantic retry budget, pivot cap, session caps, and strict provider-response admission
invariants.failure_behavior: Bounded, typed, provenance-correct failure. Local integrity faults stop the operation; a bad remote source cannot abort unrelated plan/watch work.

invariants.name: consistent_backup_restore_replay
invariants.protected_property: Backup observes one locked, caught-up store state; its manifest authenticates metadata, event bytes, head, and every payload. Restore and deterministic replay reproduce identity, markings, access behavior, and mission state without network/provider access.
invariants.trust_boundary: live concurrent store to disaster-recovery artifact and restored authority state
invariants.failure_behavior: Backup fails at creation if it cannot prove consistency; restore refuses tampering/corruption before publication.

invariants.name: version_and_default_fail_closed
invariants.protected_property: Every store open and import checks contract compatibility. Missing privilege/visibility fields default to least privilege or deny, never to a more visible/human state. Rollback uses a previously verified backup and does not reinterpret history.
invariants.trust_boundary: older or partial state to current runtime semantics
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: MissionDataStore constructor/import version guard, fail-closed record decoders, verified backup restore
invariants.failure_behavior: Typed incompatibility refusal or least-privilege interpretation; no silent migration and no write-down.

invariants.name: referent_before_referrer
invariants.protected_property: When a non-transactional operation appends multiple records, it writes durable referents before records that claim those referents exist. Retry/version guards prevent duplicate authoritative effects.
invariants.trust_boundary: crash between appends to referential integrity and exactly-once replay
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: shared operation-specific commit sequences documented and locked at integration boundaries
invariants.failure_behavior: A crash may leave an unreferenced fact or omit a non-authoritative audit record, never a committed claim to a missing authoritative referent or a duplicated effect.

invariants.name: clean_checkout_reconstruction
invariants.protected_property: A clean tracked checkout plus explicitly hash-pinned external assets and declared dependencies can collect and run the V6.7 validation without local caches, untracked fixtures, implicit keys, databases for no_db tests, or working-tree imports.
invariants.trust_boundary: developer workstation state to reproducible build/test environment
invariants.canonical_enforcement_point: tracked reconstruction manifest and terminal validation script that verifies the external kernel tree hash before running
historical_motivators: archived no_db suite skipped by autouse database fixture
invariants.failure_behavior: Terminal validation stops with an explicit missing/mismatched dependency or external asset; it never falls back to the foreground worktree or an undeclared installed package.
invariants.enforcement_scope: prospective reconstruction with historical external-kernel identity
